method: Maximum Pearson correlation across 25 signature features; each query cluster assigned independently
references: Published Kotlov labels for Schmitz 480, Morin 175 and Li 142 tumor profiles; RNA-seq only; panel-restricted signatures
scaling: Author median scaling per cohort; mean signature profile per published subtype, then equal-weight mean across three cohorts
limitation: Exploratory biological annotation of reconstructed partitions, not the author KNN model. No GC-like cluster is recovered. Discovery C1 and Validation C2 are weaker depleted-profile matches.
sensitivity: All discovery mappings agree across individual references. Validation C3 is mesenchymal in Schmitz/Li and GC-like in Morin; the pooled centroid favors mesenchymal.
